description: This file defines the SchedulerService interface for managing scheduled tasks within the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for starting, stopping, scheduling, rescheduling, deleting, and retrieving tasks, as well as managing the scheduler's state via mementos.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a scheduled task given its identifier.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Starts all tasks scheduled to run on startup.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Stops all tasks and cleans up the scheduler instance.

methods.name: scheduleTask
methods.description: Schedules a task based on a provided TaskDefinition and returns the Task instance.

methods.name: rescheduleTask
methods.description: Reschedules a given task, stopping and starting it anew.

methods.name: rescheduleAllTasks
methods.description: Reschedules all currently active tasks, useful during module changes.

methods.name: getRegisteredTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks available for scheduling, possibly from the database.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Fetches a task by its identifier.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a task using its UUID (added in version 2.4.0).

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Fetches a task given its name.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task using its identifier.

methods.name: saveTaskDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates a task definition, typically saving it to the database.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of system-related variables.

methods.name: saveToMemento
methods.description: Serializes the scheduler's state into an OpenmrsMemento object.

methods.name: restoreFromMemento
methods.description: Restores scheduler state from a provided memento.

methods.name: scheduleIfNotRunning
methods.description: Schedules a task if it isn't already running.
